segments.ja203:1.1: Virūpakkhehi me mettaṃ, mettaṃ erāpathehi me;
segments.ja203:1.3: Chabyāputtehi me mettaṃ, mettaṃ kaṇhāgotamakehi ca.
segments.ja203:2.1: Apādakehi me mettaṃ, mettaṃ dvipādakehi me;
segments.ja203:2.3: Catuppadehi me mettaṃ, mettaṃ bahuppadehi me.
segments.ja203:3.1: Mā maṃ apādako hiṃsi, mā maṃ hiṃsi dvipādako;
segments.ja203:3.3: Mā maṃ catuppado hiṃsi, mā maṃ hiṃsi bahuppado.
segments.ja203:4.1: Sabbe sattā sabbe pāṇā, sabbe bhūtā ca kevalā;
segments.ja203:4.3: Sabbe bhadrāni passantu, mā kañci [kiñci (syā. ka.)] pāpamāgamā.
segments.ja203:5.3: Appamāṇo saṅgho, pamāṇavantāni sarīsapāni [sirisapāni (sī. syā. pī.)];
segments.ja203:6.1: Katā me rakkhā katā me parittā, paṭikkamantu bhūtāni;
segments.ja203:6.3: Sohaṃ namo bhagavato, namo sattannaṃ sammāsambuddhānanti.
